mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% over the prior month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines below 0.2% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals economic contraction that triggers equity market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 750 and industrial production below 95.0 signals dual contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 750 and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary tightening regime (CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), aggressive monetary policy suppresses equity market returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 133,000 thousand over the prior quarter signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 700,000 units, it signals residential construction weakness that precedes economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST < 700.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 750 and real personal consumption expenditures below 400,000 million dollars signals dual contraction in housing demand and consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 750 and RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing and inflationary slowdown regime (INDPRO < 95.0 and CPIAUCSL < 220), contraction in industrial output and cooling inflation signals economic deceleration that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0 and CPIAUCSL < 220.
